brief: A software products and technology solutions company serving educational institutions, businesses and organisations, from Ghana outward. The identity must feel professional, intelligent, reliable and forward-thinking: a serious software company, never a gaming, crypto, telecoms or IT-repair look.
criteria: Success: distinct from generic tech marks, recognisable without the name, clear at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, credible to institutional decision-makers.

concepts.name: Held
concepts.idea: The A of Alfa is carved out of a disc, and its crossbar breaks out through the edge to open the disc into the C of Calix: Alfa, held within Calix.
rationale: One idea, both initials: an A you read at once, a C you notice second
The crossbar breaking out reads as connection and forward movement without an arrow
The cyan core is what the company builds: the product at the heart of the institution
A solid disc survives 16 px favicons, app icons, avatars and one-colour print
Plus Jakarta Sans wordmark matches the company website

recommendation: Held: simple, credible and ownable, with a symbol strong enough to stand alone across products, documents and screens.
next_steps: Replace the website's temporary wordmark and favicon
Apply to documents, email signatures and product login screens
